tasks.title: Investigate and fix failing tests
tasks.description: Run the test suite (npm test or vitest run) to identify which tests are failing. Read the existing test files (src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx) and their corresponding source files to understand what's breaking. Fix any bugs in the source code or update test assertions as needed to make all tests pass. Previous sessions show tests have been failing, so investigate error messages carefully. Ensure no functionality is broken during fixes.
acceptance_criteria: All test failures are diagnosed and understood
Code or test fixes are implemented
No new bugs or regressions introduced
All test files can execute without errors

tasks.title: Validate all tests pass
tasks.description: Run the complete test suite using npm test to verify all tests pass. Ensure the test suite exits with code 0 and there are no failures, errors, or warnings. Check that all test files execute successfully: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, and src/components/Calculator.test.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: No test failures, errors, or warnings
